ai-video-editor-effects 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches AI-powered video effects editing via a cloud rendering pipeline for TikTok creators and video editors.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB, with 1080p MP4 output in about 30–90 seconds.
- Features AI effects application, color grading, motion blur, text overlays, audio tracks, and export/download workflows.
- Includes automatic token and session management, session timeline, and job polling for exports.
- Handles errors and user input routing for common video editing actions.
